name: Suzumura Kaho
source:
A third-year student at Seishin Academy and the president of the archery club. She is thoughtful and very feminine. She is best friends with the vice-president, [url=/c121754]Takanashi Shizuku[/url]. Shizuku wants to follow in her example of “femininity".

[From [url=https://nexton-net.jp/ms-toybox/darkone/saiminseishidou/character_page07.html]official site[/url]]
